_about: The deep-coverage US universe: the five largest S&P 500 members in each of the eleven GICS sectors, ranked by the order of the SEC's company_tickers.json (largest market value first) as fetched on 2026-09-23, plus names added on request outside that ranking (`added` gives the date). On 2026-10-29 every other S&P 500 member was added (`added` 2026-10-29): the membership is the SPY holdings of 2026-10-15 (us_index_members snapshot 3), and each one's GICS sector is the State Street sector fund that holds it (XLB, XLC, XLE, XLF, XLI, XLK, XLP, XLRE, XLU, XLV, XLY holdings, fetched 2026-10-29 and archived under data/raw/us-index/2026-10-29/). `predecessors` are earlier registrants whose filings carry the same business's history before a holding-company reorganisation; their facts load under their own CIK and are linked here, never merged. `name` is the display name the pages show; the SEC files' own entity names (upper case, suffixes like /DE/, and for BAC a co-registrant subsidiary) are kept as filed in the database.
